guitar.modelsText: G&L Rampage (early) / Gibson Les Paul (signature model)
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Cantrell is well documented playing a G&L Rampage in early Alice in Chains years, later closely associated with Gibson Les Paul (his own signature model).
guitar.notes: Original entry correct and well documented.

tone.target: dark, dry grunge crunch with thick sustain
tone.profile: dark, dry grunge crunch with thick sustain
tone.summary: A dark, grunge tone achieved using a powerful British amp model (UK 800) combined with distortion and a scooped cabinet to deliver heavy, sustained riffs suitable for Alice in Chains' style.

rig.name: Alice in Chains - Rooster - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise inherent in high-gain grunge tones.
Add grit and mid-range punch to push the high-gain amp into a crunchy grunge territory.
blocks.gap: The OD 9 is used here for its classic crunch, simulating an overdrive pedal often used in grunge/alt rock.

blocks.purpose: Provide the core high-gain saturation and thickness required for heavy riffs.
Simulate the powerful British high-gain sound (Marshall/Mesa style) needed for heavy grunge.
Provide the necessary physical cabinet simulation (4x12) while maintaining a dark, powerful tone.
Scoop the mids and tighten the low end to achieve the characteristic dark, mid-scooped grunge crunch.
Placeholder for potential subtle movement if needed, but kept off to maintain dryness and tightness.
Minimal ambience to prevent the tone from sounding completely sterile, while adhering to the 'dry' requirement.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for a more authentic, tight grunge sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance the tightness and dark character of the low end, crucial for grunge.
